content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a question regarding connecting a [product_name] operator panel to my [product_name] controller. The cable connection is located on the opposite side from where I expected, making the cable incompatible. After consulting the provided diagrams, it seems incorrect. Does anyone have suggestions?

Are you referring to the TD or the TDE version? If it is the TD model, you cannot connect it to the [product_name] controller with [article_no]. Only the TDE can be linked to [product_name] controller [article_no] using an Ethernet cable. See additional details here: [url]
That's correct. The cable for the TD display should be connected on the left side of the [product_name] controller. The connector on the right side is reserved for extension modules.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members report confusion when connecting operator panels to [product_name] controllers, especially about which side of the device is intended for display module or extension unit connections. There is ongoing uncertainty in terminology (TD versus TDE) and about the physical constraints for cable placement, with reference documentation and diagrams proving unreliable.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and simple compatibility between operator panels and [product_name] controllers, accompanied by accurate diagrams and documentation.
